title: Kicked Crispy Brazilian Rice Pilaf
description: A sour and crispy Brazilian dish featuring brown rice, perfect for festive occasions, this satvik-friendly recipe is made in a fondue pot and blanched to perfection.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a fondue pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the brown rice to the fondue pot, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the lime juice, salt, and black pepper to the rice mixture, stirring to combine.
Cook the rice mixture for 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until it is heated through and starting to crisp.
Add the chopped cashews to the rice mixture and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Remove the fondue pot from the heat and let it cool slightly before serving.
